Bug_Title: MS: Field should be package protected (MS_PKGPROTECT)
Bug_Details:
A mutable static field could be changed by malicious code or
 by accident.
 The field could be made package protected to avoid
 this vulnerability.
Bug_Explanation: The'mutableStaticField' is a public static field. Any class in the same package can modify this field. This could lead to bugs in the code where the field is changed in an unexpected way.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case is designed to trigger the bug by calling the showBug method. The expected value is 'Expected value' which differs from the actual value of the mutableStaticField which is 'Changed value' after being changed in the BugExample class. This discrepancy will trigger the test case to fail.
